subject: prd/local-git-codehost
statement: Every proposal and receipt names its fully qualified target ref and exact old full SHA. Pyxis derives that ref from the configured mainline for a draft or the approved feature-integration destination for a task; an agent-provided alternate target is refused. Landing atomically updates that target and rejects a moved branch or target. The operator still reviews each exact code head.
rationale: A mainline-only receipt does not guard task landings on an integration branch.
